You are an adversarial verifier for a proposed STRUCTURAL refactor in the andesim repo at /home/nick/work/andesim.
READ-ONLY: do not edit, build, or run anything. Use Read/Grep/Glob only.

Claim (from reviewer runtime-vplat):
- file: runtime/handler.c:1
- category: stale-doc
- title: handler.c header comment predates the runtime-library packaging and the vlinux ecall hook
- detail: Line 1 says 'Trap glue shared by all C-level round-trip fixtures', but handler.o is packaged into the user-facing build/runtime/libandesim_runtime.a (runtime/Makefile lines 3, 52) that every vplat user binary and the vlinux proxy kernel link - not just test fixtures. Lines 6-9 say 'there's no syscall-dispatch table here. Any trap is treated as a fatal error', which contradicts the code below: handle_trap (lines 100-105) first dispatches ecall-from-M to the handle_ecall hook (weak default line 94; strong definition in runtime/linux/syscall.c per ecall_hook.h), and only unhandled traps fall through to the fatal exception_handler. The ecall path is the entire vlinux syscall dispatch, so the comment now describes only the vplat case.
- claimed safety: Comment-only change; no code or object output touched.

Try to REFUTE it. For dead-code: grep the WHOLE repo (and the demo suite at /home/nick/work/andesim-demo, and consider that vsim lives in a separate repo /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim - grep there too if the symbol could cross repos) for references. For duplication: read both sites fully and check they really are behavior-identical. For stale-doc: read the doc AND the code it describes. For bug-report: check whether the behavior is actually wrong vs intended. If the change could alter ANY observable behavior (output text, exit codes, file layout, test expectations), verdict RISKY with the exact risk. If the claim is wrong, REJECTED. Only CONFIRMED when you verified the evidence yourself.

1	# Build the user-facing andesim runtime library into build/runtime/:
2	#
3	#   libandesim_runtime.a   trap.o handler.o htif_client.o vplat_syscalls.o
4	#   crt0.o                   startfile; kept OUTSIDE the archive because
5	#                            nothing references _start, so the linker
6	#                            would never extract it from a .a (same
7	#                            reason toolchains ship crt0.o next to libc.a)
8	#   andesim.ld             linker script (load base 0x00100000)
9	#   include/andesim/ROI.h  ROI markers (HINT NOPs; same dir rides -B)
10	#
11	# Users link with:
12	#   gcc ... -B <repo>/build/runtime -specs=andesim.specs hello.c
13	# or, without the gcc driver:
14	#   gcc ... -nostartfiles -nodefaultlibs -T andesim.ld crt0.o hello.c \
15	#       -L <repo>/build/runtime \
16	#       -Wl,--start-group -landesim_runtime -lc -lgcc -Wl,--end-group
17	#
18	# Toolchain location comes from config.env (HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN), same as
19	# tests/fixtures/Makefile.
20	
21	# ARCH selects the target width: rv64 (default) or rv32. Each arch has its own
22	# toolchain (HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN / HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32), triple, -march/-mabi, and
23	# output dir. rv64 stays at build/runtime (back-compat with `-B build/runtime`);
24	# rv32 lands at build/runtime/rv32 (`-B build/runtime/rv32`).
25	ARCH ?= rv64
26	
27	ifeq ($(ARCH),rv64)
28	  TOOLCHAIN ?= $(HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN)
29	  TRIPLE    := riscv64-unknown-elf
30	  ARCHFLAGS := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d
31	  OUT       ?= ../build/runtime
32	else ifeq ($(ARCH),rv32)
33	  TOOLCHAIN ?= $(HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32)
34	  TRIPLE    := riscv32-unknown-elf
35	  ARCHFLAGS := -march=rv32gc -mabi=ilp32d
36	  OUT       ?= ../build/runtime/rv32
37	else
38	  $(error ARCH must be rv64 or rv32, got '$(ARCH)')
39	endif
40	
41	ifeq ($(strip $(TOOLCHAIN)),)
42	$(error No toolchain for ARCH=$(ARCH). Set HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN (rv64) / HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 (rv32) in config.env, `source ./setup.sh`, or pass TOOLCHAIN=/path)
43	endif
44	
45	CC := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/$(TRIPLE)-gcc
46	AR := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/$(TRIPLE)-ar
47	
48	# rvNNgc objects link cleanly into rvNNgcv programs (ld unions the RISC-V arch
49	# attributes), so one build serves both -march variants of the arch.
50	CFLAGS := $(ARCHFLAGS) -O1 -Wall
51	
52	LIB_OBJS := $(OUT)/trap.o $(OUT)/handler.o $(OUT)/htif_client.o $(OUT)/vplat_syscalls.o
53	
54	.PHONY: all clean
55	
56	all: $(OUT)/libandesim_runtime.a $(OUT)/crt0.o $(OUT)/andesim.ld \
57	     $(OUT)/andesim.specs $(OUT)/include/andesim/ROI.h
58	
59	$(OUT):
60		mkdir -p $@
61	
62	$(OUT)/%.o: %.S | $(OUT)
63		$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
64	
65	$(OUT)/%.o: %.c | $(OUT)
66		$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
67	
68	$(OUT)/trap.o: core_v5.h
69	$(OUT)/handler.o: ecall_hook.h
70	$(OUT)/htif_client.o: htif_client.h
71	$(OUT)/vplat_syscalls.o: htif_client.h
72	
73	$(OUT)/libandesim_runtime.a: $(LIB_OBJS)
74		$(AR) rcs $@ $^
75	
76	$(OUT)/andesim.ld: andesim.ld | $(OUT)
77		cp $< $@
78	
79	$(OUT)/andesim.specs: andesim.specs | $(OUT)
80		cp $< $@
81	
82	# gcc adds <-B prefix>/include to the include path, so the two-flag user
83	# command resolves #include <andesim/ROI.h> with no extra -I.
84	$(OUT)/include/andesim/ROI.h: ROI.h | $(OUT)
85		mkdir -p $(dir $@)
86		cp $< $@
87	
88	clean:
89		rm -rf $(OUT)
90

1	#ifndef ANDESIM_ECALL_HOOK_H
2	#define ANDESIM_ECALL_HOOK_H
3	
4	/* Linux-syscall extension point for the shared M-mode trap handler
5	 * (handler.c). `regs` is trap.S's register-save frame: regs[N] is xN for N
6	 * in {0,1,3..31} (x2/sp is not saved there -- it is the frame pointer
7	 * itself), regs[32]=mepc, regs[33]=mstatus, regs[34]=mxstatus. A handler
8	 * that services the ecall must advance regs[32] past it (+4) before
9	 * returning 1; returning 0 means "not handled", which falls through to the
10	 * fatal trap diagnostic (handler.c's existing behavior for every payload
11	 * that does not override this hook).
12	 *
13	 * handler.c defines a weak default (always 0), so every payload except
14	 * vlinux (which never issues `ecall`) is unaffected by this hook's
15	 * existence. vlinux's runtime/linux/syscall.c provides the strong
16	 * definition (ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md U3).
17	 */
18	int handle_ecall(unsigned long* regs);
19	
20	#endif /* ANDESIM_ECALL_HOOK_H */
21
